title: Presenting the Jade Seal
next_chapter_hook: The moment the golden inscriptions faded, a gaze piercing through the endless void arrived—that was a gaze from beyond the Three Realms, carrying the cold indifference and playfulness of one examining chess pieces. Chen Ji suddenly understood that the chess game he had meticulously arranged might never have escaped the sight of higher beings.

text.content:
Above the grand hall, silence sank like an abyss.

While the ministers' kneeling sounds still echoed in their ears, Zhang Wudi had already risen slowly from the dragon throne. His low murmur, repressing anger - 'The Observer... Let me see exactly how much Heavenly Secrets this Observer can truly observe' - sounded especially clear in the dead silent court.

Chen Ji stood below the crimson steps, his expression calm as still water in an ancient well, only a faint, barely perceptible cold gleam flickering in the depths of his eyes. A废物杂役? Heh, he had been waiting precisely for this moment.

"Issue my decree—"

Zhang Wudi's voice suddenly rose, echoing through the empty grand hall. He strode down from the dragon throne, the nine-streamed crown gently swaying, the dark dragon robe on his body gleaming with cold light under the sun.

"Starting today, I shall formally grant the Imperial Seal of the Great Zhou—our most treasured heirloom—to Chen Ji!"

At these words, the ministers erupted in shock. Wang Chong, Minister of Justice, abruptly raised his head, face filled with disbelief; the ceremonial tablet slipped from the hands of the Vice Minister of Rites, clattering to the ground with a loud sound; and those Censors who had just been whispering now looked as pale as death, as if they had heard some utterly fantastical tale.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji rendered great service in protecting the throne, quelling internal rebellion, and founding a peaceful era. Such a meritorious subject—how could we allow such talent to be buried under the lowly title of a menial servant?"

Zhang Wudi's words were weighty and resonant, each syllable striking the hearts of the ministers. His gaze swept over Chen Ji, the corner of his lips curving into a meaning-filled arc—not appreciation, but the composure of a hunter watching prey step into a trap.

"The Imperial Seal is granted by Heaven's Mandate. Today I place it in your hands, hoping you will... conduct yourself wisely."

text.content:
Chen Ji bowed his head to receive the imperial decree, his voice flat as water: "This commoner... accepts the decree."

He reached out and took the rosewood box handed over by the eunuch. The moment the lid opened, a vast and boundless aura rushed forth—like a sea, carrying the accumulated might of imperial authority over thousands of years, enough to make any Foundation Building cultivator's soul scatter.

However, in the next instant, a sudden anomaly occurred.

The completely white Imperial Seal within the box abruptly burst forth with dazzling golden light, countless golden inscriptions surging forth like a tide, converging into a brilliant curtain of light before Chen Ji!

"This is..."

The ministers cried out in alarm and retreated. Wang Chong, Minister of Justice, stared wide-eyed, his lips trembling as he failed to speak—himself had seen the Imperial Seal before, yet never had he witnessed such an异象.

The golden inscriptions were ancient and desolate, as if from the very beginning of heaven and earth. They churned, arranged, and reorganized within the curtain of light, ultimately condensing into a shocking line of large characters:

【In thirty days, beyond the Three Realms, the seal will open】

The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's embrace suddenly trembled violently, emitting a sharp humming sound, as if sensing some kindred force.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the shock in his heart, his expression still calm as usual. He slightly narrowed his eyes, whispering in a voice only he could hear: "Beyond the Three Realms... interesting."

The trembling of the Tianji Record Fragment grew increasingly intense, Mo Xiansheng's aged voice resonating in his mind: "This inscription's aura... this old man sensed similar fluctuations a thousand years ago. This is the source power of the complete Tianji Record, sealed within this seal using imperial authority as the medium!"

"The complete Tianji Record?" Chen Ji's heart stirred.

"Not just the complete version," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried unprecedented gravity, "the source indicated by this inscription is far more terrifying than you can imagine."

text.content:
The golden curtain of light continued to churn, and new inscriptions emerged:

【Heavenly Fate: Overdraft】
【Deduction Authority: Restricted】
【Source Location: Unresolvable】

Chen Ji's brow slightly furrowed—this inscription was actually reading his Tianji Record status? More bizarrely, that "Source Location: Unresolvable" prompt was clearly telling him that the source of this information was not within the Three Realms.

Not within the Three Realms, then...

Beyond the Three Realms?

The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly emitted a violent tremor, Chen Ji's vision blurred, and the entire fragment actually flipped open to its final page—that was a blank page that had never appeared before, now visibly condensing new content at a visible speed!

"This is..."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

He saw the text on that blank page writhing like a living creature, ultimately converging into a complete scene—it was a vast and boundless void, with no heaven, no earth, no any living beings, only endless darkness and nothingness.

And at the very center of the void, a colossal eye was slowly opening.

That eye had no pupil, only endless abyss and chaos. But the moment it opened, Chen Ji felt a pressure unprecedented—coming from a higher dimension, a gaze overlooking beyond the rules of the Three Realms.

【Tianji Record·Complete Version First Unlocked】
【Deduction Ability: All-Seeing Window】
【Consumption: 50 Heavenly Fate points/use】

choice.prompt: The complete Tianji Record revealed its true Heavenly Secrets deduction ability for the first time, yet that Eye of the Void is also gazing upon you. At this moment, what will you decide?

choices.text: Immediately deduce the nature of that eye
choices.description: Consume 50 Heavenly Fate points, attempt to deduce the origin and weaknesses of the Eye of the Void using the All-Seeing Window
choices.visible_reward: Unlock key intelligence: The true identity of the Eye of the Void
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate was already tight; overdraft may lead to unpredictable consequences

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, his will moved, and the golden text on the Tianji Record Fragment flashed madly. 50 Heavenly Fate points flowed away like water, his face instantly paled several shades, yet his gaze grew increasingly sharp.

The All-Seeing Window opened.

In an instant, endless information flooded into his Mental Sea like a torrent—that was everything about that eye: its name, its origin, its connection to the Tianji Record, and... its true relationship with the "Observer."

dialogue.content:
"Heh... so that's how it is."

Chen Ji murmured with a low laugh, a flash of understanding passing through his eyes. The true identity of that Eye of the Void was actually—

"The Eye of Heavenly Dao." His voice was pressed extremely low, yet carried an inexplicable chill, "A being beyond the Three Realms, the true master of the Tianji Record... so it has always been there."

Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly resounded, carrying unprecedented shock: "What did you say? The Eye of Heavenly Dao?! That legendary... how is this possible!"

text.content:
The golden curtain of light churned once more, and new inscriptions emerged—

【Deduction Result: Eye of Heavenly Dao·本体】
【Level: Transcendent Existence】
【Association: Tianji Record Source】
【Status: Dormant·About to Awaken】

Chen Ji stared fixedly at the last line, his heart slowly sinking. Dormant... about to awaken. This meant that eye was not actively gazing at him, but some kind of automatic sensing mechanism.

Like a hunter setting a trap and waiting for prey to walk into the net.

And the Tianji Record in his hands might be the bait leading him into the trap.

choices.text: Make no move, quietly observe the changes
choices.description: Not in a hurry to consume Heavenly Fate points, first observe this eye's reactions and intentions
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Heavenly Fate, observe the enemy's movements
choices.risk_hint: May miss the critical intelligence window period

text.content:
Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart and chose to make no move.

He knew all too well—the more he faced unknown dangers, the less he should expose his trump cards. Though that Eye of the Void was terrifying, its current state was clearly dormant automatic sensing, not active attack.

If he recklessly consumed Heavenly Fate points to deduce, he might instead alert it.

"Mo Xiansheng," he asked in his heart, "this Eye of Heavenly Dao... have you ever heard of it?"

After a moment of silence, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded: "In legends... that is the most ancient Observer. It is not some specific living being, but a collective consciousness. It has existed since the very beginning of heaven and earth, specifically responsible for... observation and recording."

dialogue.content:
"Observation and recording?" Chen Ji's brow slightly lifted.

"Indeed." Mo Xiansheng's voice turned low. "Legend has it that the Eye of Heavenly Secrets records all beings with the potential to peer into heavenly secrets within the Three Realms, and the Tianji Record... is the tool it grants to those under observation."

Chen Ji's heart tightened. A tool?

"You're saying the Tianji Record was always a pawn set up by that thing from the beginning?"

"Not just the Tianji Record," Mo Xiansheng's voice carried deep worry. "The prophets who have held the Tianji Record through the ages... perhaps were all its pawns. Including Chen Xuan, including myself."

text.content:
The golden light curtain continued to shift, that void eye still quietly suspended in endless darkness. But at this moment, a new line of inscriptions appeared:

[Non-standard response detected]
[Target: Tianji Record Holder · Chen Ji]
[Response anomaly: Divination not triggered]
[Adjusting strategy: Waiting]

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. As expected, this Eye of Heavenly Secrets wasn't truly "seeing" him, but rather a programmed detection mechanism. And his "not following the usual pattern" seemed to have confused this mechanism.

"Interesting..." A faint smile curved his lips. "It seems this chessboard is far more complex than I imagined."

The golden light curtain suddenly shuddered. The line "Adjusting strategy: Waiting" vanished, replaced by a line of even more glaring blood-red warning:

[Warning: Target response deviates from preset parameters]
[Initiating secondary observation protocol]
[Countdown: 29 days 23 shi]

Chen Ji's pupils contracted. Secondary observation protocol? With a countdown?

This meant—the seal opening thirty days later wasn't a pure natural event, but a... hunt? Directed at him.

"Mo Xiansheng," his voice was extremely low, "if I haven't guessed wrong, the end of this countdown is likely when that Eye of Heavenly Secrets fully awakens."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while before speaking with difficulty: "Perhaps... it is already awakening."

At this moment, the golden light curtain suddenly剧烈波动起来。

That giant eye suspended in the void微微转动，仿佛……正在看向他。

Chen Ji's heart leapt——那不是程序的自动感应，而是真正的注视！

"它发现我了？" He下意识想要启动天机录的防御，却发现身体仿佛被某种力量定住了一般。

金色铭文疯狂闪烁，浮现出一行触目惊心的文字：

【二级观测协议激活】
【目标锁定中……】
【警告：天命值异常波动】

Chen Ji怀中的天机录残页猛然发烫，几乎要将他手掌灼伤。那原本还算稳定的空白页面此刻竟开始自行翻动，每一页都写满了密密麻麻的警告文字。

"不对……" He眉头紧锁，"这不是倒计时的警告，而是——"

话音未落，一道苍老而熟悉的声音在他脑海中炸响："Chen Ji! 快停下！"

是Mo Xiansheng的声音，却带着前所未有的惊恐。

"那天道之眼在读取你的天机录！它在——"

声音戛然而止。

Chen Ji低头看向手中的残页，只见原本泛着淡金色光芒的页面正在以肉眼可见的速度变得暗淡，仿佛有什么东西正在将它的力量抽离出去。

"怎么回事？"

Chen Ji面色微变，却依然保持着表面的镇定。

天机录残页的震颤愈发剧烈，Mo Xiansheng的声音断断续续地响起："那天道之眼……它在反向解析天机录！它要收回——"

"收回什么？"

"收回……历代预言者的……记忆……"

Mo Xiansheng的声音越来越虚弱，仿佛随时都会消散。Chen Ji心头一沉——Mo Xiansheng本身就是残魂状态，若是记忆被抽离，那后果……

金色光幕上的铭文再次变化：

【解析进度：12%】
【记忆抽取中……】
【预计完成时间：30息】

Chen Ji猛然抬头，目光如刀般刺向那只依然在缓缓转动的虚空巨眼。

三十息。

他只有三十息的时间做出抉择。

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji! 快切断与天机录的连接！" Mo Xiansheng的声音带上了从未有过的急切，"那东西在借天机录抽取我的记忆——不，不只是我，它在抽取历代所有预言者留下的痕迹！"

"切断连接？" Chen Ji嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，"然后呢？让它得逞之后从容退去？"

他深吸一口气，做出了一个让Mo Xiansheng都为之震惊的举动——

他主动将自己的神识灌入了天机录之中。

"你疯了！" Mo Xiansheng惊呼，"那样你会被——"

"会被它读取？" Chen Ji打断了他，声音平静得可怕，"那我就让它读个够。"

他的眼中闪过一丝狡黠的光芒，那是一个猎人设下陷阱时的从容与狠厉。

"既然它想看我的底牌，那我就让它看看——我Chen Ji，究竟布下了怎样的一张网。"

text.content:
Chen Ji的神识如同一柄利刃，直直刺入了天机录的核心区域。

刹那间，无尽的信息流将他淹没——那是历代预言者的记忆残片，是天机录数千年来积累的所有秘密，是三界之内无数因果纠缠的丝线。

而在那所有一切的尽头，那只虚空之眼正静静注视着他。

没有敌意，没有杀意，只有一种纯粹的……好奇。

仿佛在看一只终于落入陷阱的猎物，又仿佛在看一枚终于起作用的棋子。

Chen Ji与那只眼睛对视，心中忽然涌起一股明悟——

这不是他与天道之眼的第一次交锋。

从一开始，他获得天机录的那一刻起，这场博弈就已经开始了。

而现在，是时候让对方看看，他这个"废物"，究竟成长到了什么地步。

"想看我的底牌？" He嘴角微扬，"那就让你看个够。"

金色光幕骤然凝固。

那只虚空巨眼停止了转动，仿佛被什么东西吸引住了全部注意力。

而在Chen Ji的识海深处，一道从未显露过的符文正在缓缓成形——那是天机录完整版的真正形态，是历代预言者穷尽一生都无法触及的禁忌知识。

【天机录·完整版】
【推演能力：命运丝线】
【效果：可同时推演最多十条命运线的走向】
【消耗：天命值30点/线】
【隐藏效果：可感知同一存在布下的命运线】

Chen Ji瞳孔微缩。感知同一存在布下的命运线……这是专门用来对付"天道之眼"的能力！

他猛然抬头，看向那只虚空之眼的目光中多了几分玩味：

"原来如此。你不是来杀我的，你是来看看……我有没有资格成为真正的棋手。"

dialogue.content:
就在此时，那只虚空之眼终于有了反应。

它缓缓转动，瞳孔的位置对准了Chen Ji。一股浩瀚如海的信息流瞬间涌入他的识海，那是天道之眼的……回应。

【有趣】
【千年以来，第一个敢于主动接触本体的存在】
【你的回应已记录在案】
【三十日后，封印开启之时，便是棋局正式开始之日】
【届时，本体会亲自……观测】

最后两个字带着一股难以言喻的压迫感，仿佛高高在上的神明在俯视蝼蚁。

但Chen Ji却笑了。

"观测？" His voice平静而淡漠，"那我就等着你来观测。"

text.content:
金色光幕骤然消散。

那只虚空之眼连同无尽的黑暗一起，如潮水般退去。传国玉玺恢复了原本莹白无瑕的模样，仿佛方才的一切都只是幻觉。

但Chen Ji知道，那不是幻觉。

天机录残页的最后一页，多出了一行金色的文字：

【首次接触完成】
【天道之眼·关注度+1】
【解锁隐藏任务：三十日后的棋局】
【任务目标：在封印开启前，布置一张让天道之眼都无法看透的棋局】

Chen Ji合上残页，嘴角勾起一抹意味深长的弧度。

"无法看透的棋局？" He低声道，"那我倒要看看，究竟是谁的棋艺更胜一筹。"

他抬起头，看向高位上依然保持着从容微笑的Zhang Emperor，目光幽深如渊。

这场戏，才刚刚开始。

大殿之上，群臣依然保持着跪拜的姿势，脸上写满了震惊与惶恐。

他们虽然看不清那金色光幕中究竟写了什么，但方才玉玺散发出的那股浩瀚威压，却是实打实地压在他们心头。此刻见Chen Ji收起了玉玺，一个个不由得屏住了呼吸，生怕触怒了这位新贵。

Zhang Emperor从龙椅上站起身来，脸上的笑容愈发和煦："Chen爱卿，玉玺可还称手？"

Chen Ji微微躬身，声音平淡："承蒙陛下厚爱，臣……感激不尽。"

"哈哈哈！" Zhang Emperor大笑三声，仿佛心中大石终于落地，"好！好！好！朕就知道，Chen爱卿绝非池中之物！"

他的目光与Chen Ji短暂交汇，其中意味，只有当事人自己清楚。

而在无人注意的角落，刑部尚书Wang Chong悄悄抬起头，看向Chen Ji的目光中多了几分意味深长的光芒。

choice.prompt: 玉玺异象已过，但暗流涌动。此刻朝堂之上，你需要做出下一步的表态。是接受玉玺带来的权势，还是借机布局更深层次的棋局？

choices.description: 以功臣自居，接受皇帝给予的相应封赏与权力扩张
choices.visible_reward: 正式进入大周权力核心，名望大幅提升

text.content:
Chen Ji微微一笑，从容地接过圣旨与玉玺，声音清朗："臣Chen Ji，谢主隆恩！"

这一声谢恩如同一记重锤，砸在所有心怀叵测之人的心头。

废物杂役，一朝封侯拜相。这简直是话本里才有的桥段，此刻却真真切切地发生在了眼前。

"Chen侯爷！"

群臣纷纷上前道贺，一个个脸上堆满了虚伪的笑容。礼部侍郎亲自上前引路，态度恭敬得令人发指；就连方才还一脸冷漠的禁军统领，此刻也低下了高傲的头颅。

Chen Ji一一应付着，嘴角始终挂着淡淡的微笑，眼神却深邃如渊。

封侯？

呵，这只是第一步而已。

choices.description: 表面推辞封赏，实则向皇帝与群臣展示谦逊姿态
choices.visible_reward: 进一步巩固"忠厚"人设，降低各方警惕

text.content:
Chen Ji忽然跪下，声音诚恳："陛下厚爱，臣惶恐。只是臣资质愚钝，恐难当此大任……"

话未说完，Zhang Emperor便笑着打断了他："哎，Chen爱卿何必自谦？方才那等异象，满朝文武可都是亲眼所见。若非天命所归，岂会有此神迹？"

群臣连连称是。

Chen Ji低着头，眸中闪过一丝玩味。这Zhang Emperor倒是会顺水推舟，把玉玺的异象说成是"天命所归"，既堵住了悠悠众口，又把他牢牢绑在了皇室的战车上。

高，实在是高。

"既然陛下如此说……" Chen Ji抬起头，眼中满是"被感动"的神色，"那臣便斗胆领命。只是臣才疏学浅，日后还望诸位同僚多多指教。"

说着，他向群臣拱了拱手，姿态谦逊得无懈可击。

可他的心里，却在默默计算着另一笔账。

choices.description: Seizing the opportunity of the Jade Seal Omen, he proposed to the Emperor a request to investigate the truth at the Ancient Forbidden Land
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his interest in the Forbidden Grounds
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining a legitimate reason to go to the Forbidden Grounds, preparing for the Chess Game thirty days later
choices.risk_hint: Possibly arousing further attention from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao

text.content:
Chen Ji pondered for a moment, then suddenly raised his head and said: "Your Majesty, the inscription revealed in the Jade Seal Omen just now, this minister has some understanding of it. The phrase 'Beyond the Three Realms, the Seal Opens' seems to relate to the Ancient Forbidden Land."

At these words, the court erupted in an uproar.

Emperor Zhang Wu's brow slightly arched as he gazed at Chen Ji with keen interest: "Oh? What insights does Minister Chen have?"

"This minister believes," Chen Ji's voice was unhurried and steady, "this matter concerns the safety of Great Zhou and the survival of the Three Realms. Though I am unworthy, I am willing to volunteer to go to the Ancient Forbidden Land and investigate the truth."

The ministers exchanged bewildered glances. Was he volunteering to walk into the tiger's den?

Only Chen Ji himself knew what lay hidden in that Ancient Forbidden Land—it was the flaw in the Chess Game arranged by the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, the key to breaking his impasse.

Thirty days.

He had to grasp sufficient leverage before then.

Emperor Zhang Wu meditated for a moment, then suddenly laughed: "Excellent! Minister Chen is truly loyal and patriotic. This is granted!"
